title: Day 690 — Rocha Moya Requests Indefinite Leave Again After Sheinbaum, Morena Distance Themselves
detail: On August 22, 2026 (Day 690, Saturday) at 6:40 p.m., Rubén Rocha Moya requested leave from the Sinaloa governorship for a second time — an indefinite leave submitted by letter to the state Congress — just one day after unilaterally reincorporating himself into the post over the April 29 U.S. DOJ indictment tying him to the Sinaloa Cartel's "Los Chapitos" faction. President Sheinbaum publicly distanced herself from his return, saying "Sinaloa, la nación y el movimiento de transformación están por encima de todo" and that "ningún interés personal" should be placed above "los intereses del pueblo y de la Nación," warning against "ambición desnuda del poder por el poder"; Morena and the Interior Secretariat also publicly broke with him. Former DEA director Derek Maltz called for Rocha's arrest and deportation. The Sinaloa Congress suspended its session to select an interim governor, postponing the decision.

media.caption: Rocha Moya requests an indefinite leave from the Sinaloa governorship, one day after returning to office

title: Day 690 — Sheinbaum Inaugurates Archivo General Agrario in Mexico City
detail: On August 22, 2026 (Day 690, Saturday), President Sheinbaum inaugurated the Centro Nacional de Atención Agraria and Archivo General Agrario in Mexico City — a facility housing the Registro Agrario Nacional, the Procuraduría Agraria, and the country's historical agrarian records. Agrarian Secretary Edna Elena Vega Rangel called it "the second in importance after the Archivo General de la Nación," with over 45,000 linear meters of documents, including more than 100,000 maps and land-tenure records dating to 1917 and colonial-era materials, plus the decrees of all Fourth Transformation land-restitution grants (60,000+ hectares to date). Construction began in 2022 under President López Obrador on land donated by Sheinbaum during her tenure as Mexico City mayor.

media.caption: Sheinbaum inaugurates the Centro Nacional de Atención Agraria and Archivo General Agrario in Mexico City
